name: io.github.YazanAlabed/aigradjobs
title: AIGradJobs
description: Find early-career AI/ML jobs, compare salaries, review resumes and audit public GitHub portfolios.

tools.name: search_ai_jobs
tools.description: Search verified early-career AI/ML roles with stack and COL purchasing power intel.

tools.name: check_resume_fit
tools.description: Compare a candidate's resume against live early-career AI/ML ATS keywords and return top matching open roles.

tools.name: get_interview_prep
tools.description: Retrieve tailored technical interview knockout questions and a weekend portfolio project for a specific role.

tools.name: compare_real_purchasing_power
tools.description: Compare two positive annual USD offers using US=100 cost-of-living indices; international city values are illustrative assumptions, not live FX. Convert local currencies to USD first.

tools.name: get_market_salary_benchmark
tools.description: Return disclosed annual USD pay statistics (range endpoints and median midpoint) and top skills from matching active job listings; no salary or currency guesses.

tools.name: audit_github_for_role
tools.description: Audit up to 15 recently updated public GitHub repository metadata records against an active job's stack; return the two best matching owned repos and biggest skill evidence gap. No private repo or source-code access.
